findings.claim: docs/WIRING.md's tier-law paragraph claims the fence-side re-judgment applies unconditionally at both transports, but commits 7ef774b/579236b made it conditional on the citing commit being at-or-after FENCE_TIER_CUTOVER_COMMIT (3bf3bac), and the paragraph's only grandfathering clause is record-age-based, which does not cover the nine settled fence-surface-scoped records created after the scope-law cutover (lane 5f1).
